# S3 + S3.5: Multiply, then the claim and the correction

**Model:** Opus 5.5, high. **Paste to start:** `Read CLAUDE.md, then docs/build/STATUS.md and docs/build/scenes/S3.md, and do S3 and S3.5. Stop for my review at the key frames, and again at the end.`
**Spec:** `sed -n 288,307p PROTEST_VIZ_SPEC.md` (S3). S3.5 is new (Vali, 2026-11-12) and has no spec section: this brief is its spec. Shared rules: [README.md](README.md).

## Purpose
- **S3:** one becomes many: `n(p) = round(380^p)`, scrub-safe both ways.
- **S3.5:** the same 380 roaches sort into "Indian" / "Pakistani" at the minister's split, then re-sort to Dipke's >94% Indian. Nothing is born or killed in S3.5. Its end layout is where S4's converge starts.

## Allowed data keys
- S3: none on screen (the swarm is the content).
- S3.5: `timeline.nodes[start].sub_beats[start_pushback].facts[]`, the fact whose text mentions "Pakistani": **both sentences verbatim**, split at the sentence boundary (claim caption, then correction caption), with `claimant`, `attribution` and `status`. `metrics.rows` where `metric` is `"Share of Pakistani followers"` (49, disputed) and `"Share of Indian audience"` (>94%, disputed).
- "Indian 51%" = 100 − 49, attributed to the **same claimant and status** as the 49% row (Vali, 2026-11-12; logged in GAPS). "Elsewhere" is UI wording and carries **no number**.

## Files it owns
- `src/scenes/s03-multiply.js`, `src/scenes/s03-5-claim.js` (+ CSS).
- May add to `src/roach/swarm.js` (additive only; don't break S0).

## Must not touch
The common list in README.

## Contracts it consumes
- `ctx.swarm` (shared pool): roach *i* is the same individual from S0 to S4. S3 uses the first `n(p)`; S3.5 uses 380.
- Prologue layers, `roach()`, `rng()`/`hash01()` for any randomness (seeded, so pure in `p`).
- Port source for S3.5: v2 `index.html` "01 · The swarm" (~lines 728–800, `SPLITS` 2 → 3, `phyllo()`); in motion `stagger([0, 700], { from: 'random' })` + `inOutQuart`, expressed as a function of `p` (per-roach delay, not a timeline). The storyboard's static version is in `design/storyboard.js` (`clusters()`, `s35Frame()`): reuse its layout maths.

## Key frames
| p | Expected picture | Storyboard |
|---|---|---|
| S3 0.10 | First split: 2 roaches. Founder still large, shrinking. | none |
| S3 0.30 | Founder has reached swarm size; no marker from here on. | none |
| S3 0.80 | n = 116; births spread outward from the founder spot; youngest (outermost) still scaling in. No text. | `ink-S3.png` |
| S3.5 0.30 | The claim: two phyllotaxis clusters; Indian 51% (white) left, Pakistani 49% (red, state action) right; claimant · DISPUTED under each; caption = first sentence, verbatim, with `*`. | `ink-S3-5-claim.png` |
| S3.5 0.60 | Mid-transition: roaches leave the red cluster in random stagger, arcing left, dropping the red as they cross. | `ink-S3-5-mid.png` |
| S3.5 0.90 | The correction: Indian >94% (Dipke, disputed); small "Elsewhere" cluster, no number, at 55% alpha; caption = second sentence with `*`. | `ink-S3-5-rebut.png` |

## Done when
- S3 count tracks `p` both ways, no popping; scrolling up removes the **most recently born first, walking back into their parent** (spec). 60 fps.
- S2 p 1 = S3 p 0 (one founder roach); S3 p 1 = S3.5 p 0; S3.5 p 1 = S4 p 0 (S4b will match it).
- Captions verbatim; every number has a `*` and its claimant.
- QA both ways (`targets/S3.json`, `targets/S3-5.json`), compare sheets with down≠up 0%, `qa-shell` all PASS.

- S3.5 claim frame uses the minister's numbers on both sides (51/49); the correction frame keeps "Elsewhere" without a number (2026-11-12).
